senses.gloss: m. (cmp. דּוּךְ II) place to stand on, stand, stage, esp. Dukhan, the priests’stage from which they pronounce the benediction.
units: Midd. II, 6; a. fr.—עלה לד׳ to go up the stage, to officiate as priest.
Sabb. 118ᵇ; a. e.—2) religious service from the stand, the Levite’s singing, teaching.

<cite ref="Megillah 3a:18">Meg. 3ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Arakhin 4a:55">Arakh. 4ᵃ</cite> the Levites <he>מִדּוּכָנָן</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>בר׳</he>) must interrupt their services.—Pl. <he>דּוּכָנִים</he>, <he>דּוּכָנִין</he>, v. <cite ref="D00244"><he>דּוּךְ</he> III</cite>. Cmp. <cite ref="D00765"><he>דָּכוֹן</he></cite>.
